finding.title: Buffer Overflow or Underflow
finding.assumptions: The SIZE variable is defined elsewhere and may be attacker-controlled or user-defined. The multiplication of chunkSize with SIZE can overflow.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The multiplication of chunkSize with SIZE can result in a negative value, leading to an allocation of 0 bytes. This may not be a direct injection point but is a potential issue with negative sizes.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.assumptions: The input_FileDesc can be manipulated by an attacker, leading to unexpected behavior or injection points.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The output_FileDesc can be manipulated by an attacker, leading to unexpected behavior or injection points.
